name: cc-sticky-notes
description: cc-sticky-notes: route curiosity questions to a side pane instead of the main conversation

routeThreshold.title: Route threshold
routeThreshold.description: Minimum Jev confidence before asking the user

followupThreshold.title: Follow-up threshold
followupThreshold.description: Minimum is_followup confidence to attach under the active thread

summaryProvider.title: Summary provider
summaryProvider.description: claude | openai — which model does titles, summaries, outlines and the knowledge side path

claudeModel.title: Claude model
claudeModel.description: Model for the summary layer ($.model.complete) when summaryProvider is claude: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id. Fork answers always use the main session model.

claudeEffort.title: Claude effort
claudeEffort.description: Effort for $.model.complete when summaryProvider is claude

openaiModel.title: OpenAI model
openaiModel.description: OpenAI model for the summary layer

openaiReasoningEffort.title: OpenAI reasoning effort
openaiReasoningEffort.description: reasoning_effort for gpt-5 family models; 'minimal' keeps short summary jobs from spending the whole token cap on reasoning. 'none' leaves the parameter out (non-reasoning models).

openaiContextMode.title: OpenAI context mode
openaiContextMode.description: off | redacted | full — what project content may be sent to OpenAI

openaiDailyTokenCap.title: OpenAI daily token cap
openaiDailyTokenCap.description: Pause OpenAI calls past this many tokens per UTC day

autoOpenPane.title: Auto-open pane
autoOpenPane.description: Open the pane (and select the new note) when a sidebar answer arrives

contextIndexMaxTokens.title: Context index max tokens
contextIndexMaxTokens.description: Token budget for the title index injected via prompt.context (M3)
